# AI Vision Consulting

> Practical AI and Microsoft 365 Copilot training and automation consulting for organisations, professionals, jobseekers and community groups. Based in Newcastle upon Tyne, delivering online across the UK and in person in Newcastle and the North East. Founded by Eric Nwankwo. Rated 5.0 on Google.

## Key Facts

- Team workshops are priced per workshop, not per person: £995 for 90 minutes (up to 15 people), £1,450 for a half day (up to 20 people), £2,450 for a full day (up to 20 people), and £4,800 for a committed programme of six 90 minute workshops (up to 15 people, £800 per workshop).
- Individual training: 13 Practical AI topics and a Microsoft 365 Copilot for Work route, in one hour sessions. £95 for one hour, £270 for three, £510 for six, £900 for twelve.
- Private small group sessions start at £395 for 90 minutes with up to six people.
- AI policy and governance package from £1,750. AI readiness and workflow audit from £950.
- All prices are final. AI Vision Consulting is not VAT registered, so no VAT is added. Software licences and travel outside Tyne and Wear are separate.
- Completed training: a 90 minute Microsoft 365 Copilot workshop for FDQ Limited (Food and Drink Qualifications), Leeds, 3 September 2026, and a complete 12 week AI training course for the AI Vision Community.
- Books: Eric Nwankwo wrote Copilot Prompts, 100 workplace prompts for Microsoft 365 Copilot, the first title in the AI Vision Practical Guides series. It is on Amazon UK as a £4.99 Kindle eBook, also in Kindle Unlimited, and a £9.99 paperback. The second title, Copilot for Excel, 70 prompts for spreadsheets, data checks and monthly reports, has been on Amazon UK as a £4.99 Kindle eBook since 23 September 2026, also in Kindle Unlimited, with the paperback in review. The books page carries the current status and the Amazon links.

## What We Do

- Microsoft 365 Copilot training for teams in Newcastle, the North East and online across the UK
- Practical AI training for individuals and teams, covering ChatGPT, Claude and other tools
- Corporate AI workshops and capability programmes
- Workflow and automation discovery
- Small business AI automation support
- AI voice assistants that answer questions and book appointments
- Community and employability AI training
- Responsible use guidance, including privacy, human review and output checking

## Training

Copilot training teaches staff to write a clear brief with goal, context, sources and expectations, reuse custom instructions and a prompt writing agent, work with Outlook email threads and Teams meeting actions, ground answers in their own documents with Copilot Notebooks, and check figures and missing information before sharing results.

Practical AI training covers AI foundations and tool selection, prompting, AI agents and workflow automation, research, video, image and simple app creation, content systems, digital products, avatars and freelance services. Each individual session is one hour and covers one agreed focus.

## Consulting

Automation work begins with the current workflow rather than a predetermined tool. Support can include process mapping, opportunity and risk assessment, pilot design, implementation planning, testing, documentation and handover. Consulting and implementation are quoted according to the systems and work required.
